The review's example fix for Zhang, {minus: [Yangzhou 100, Nanjing 100]}, was not used because it would remove Yangzhou city (69 km from Nanjing) from Zhang's shape; the north-bank district is now three circles (Gaoyou 50, Taizhou 40, Xinghua 40) and Zhu's Nanjing circle excludes them. Three more Zhang pieces that overlapped Zhu's shape (Changzhou 17 and 8 cells, northern Jiangsu 23, Hangzhou 10) were also cut back; the review did not list them.

Anfeng loss to Zhu is confidence 1, not the 2 the review suggested: five pages opened are silent on who held Anfeng after March 1363. Anfeng attack: February 1363 (Liu Futong page) or January 1363 (Hongwu Emperor page).

Chuzhou: the review's first option was applied (han-song is not touched) but the Red Turban page (Zhu gained Chuzhou in 1353; the court 'continued to exist in safety' there) and the Han Lin'er page (silent on who controlled Chuzhou; no month for the move, only after Chen Youliang's June 1363 attack) favour the second option; see the han-song gap and the notes file.
